title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：mystery　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mystery 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the painter ① solved the mystery that no visitor in the studio would have noted, and he said the solving was the whole of the season. The ② mystery, meaning the puzzle itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed unnoted in the book; a mystery, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ mystery in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ mystery at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mystery, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the painter said the noting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mystery was the whole of the matter, meaning the secret and not the puzzle. The ⑥ mystery, meaning the secret and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; mystery, he said, is either something you solve or the only word that means both a puzzle and a secret. He said the secret is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ mystery had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ mystery of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of noting; mystery, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mystery I remember is the puzzle noted in the catalogue, which closed in 1978 and is still noted as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ mystery, my mother said in 1980, is the only puzzle that improves by being noted; every mystery, she said, is a secret that has agreed to look like a puzzle. She said the secret was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 谜；神秘的事（指画室里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 谜；神秘的事（指那个谜本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：solve the mystery 解开这一个谜
D. n. 谜；神秘的事（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 谜之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的谜之事）
F. n. 谜；神秘的事（指展品目录里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 谜、隐情（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 隐情（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: solved the mystery that no visitor in the studio would have noted
The mystery, meaning the puzzle itself and not the brush
the mystery at the far easel
the mystery was the whole of the matter
the mystery had become a line in a catalogue
The mystery of the whole thing
A mystery, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: solve the mystery 意为“解开这一个谜”，1971 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯记下的一个谜做了一遍。
mystery 意为“谜；神秘的事”，指那个谜本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记下。
mystery 意为“谜；神秘的事”，指画室里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
mystery 意为“谜；神秘的事”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mystery 意为“谜、隐情”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个隐情就是那件事的全部。
mystery 意为“隐情”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个谜，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mystery 意为“谜；神秘的事”，指展品目录里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1976 年这一个成了展品目录里的一行。
mystery 意为“谜之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的谜之事是一处画室和三个季度的记下。
mystery 意为“谜；神秘的事”，我记得的是展品目录里记下过的那一个，1978 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一个。
mystery 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，谜是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的谜。
